constraints: Preserve source identifiers in dedicated custom fields and use them as idempotent lookup keys.
Use transactions and application models for mutations where appropriate, preserving record IDs and relationships.
Remove source prefixes and placeholders from user-facing display fields only when traceability remains in dedicated fields.
Do not overwrite existing normalized display names or unrelated manual corrections on rerun.
Do not expose credentials or sensitive values in tracked files or reports.
Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and do not commit.

Current-machine verification shows referential integrity, unique source keys, zero targeted anomalies, Ruby syntax validity, and explicit self-review and independent-review evidence.
